bootstrap.event: lexically sorted unique event IDs; sample number-of-events event IDs with replacement and include every paired eligible row for each sampled occurrence; fight-weighted mean
bootstrap.fight: sample N paired row indices with replacement
bootstrap.generator: numpy.random.default_rng; reset independently per comparison and bootstrap kind
bootstrap.limitations: conditional on fitted OOF predictions; event clustering does not remove repeat-fighter dependence or training overlap
bootstrap.paired_metrics: same sampled indices/clusters for both metrics and all arms; reset seed17 each scope/kind

delta: candidate minus baseline per-fight log loss; negative favorable
report: single-best-year share of net improvement using summed losses; null if no net improvement
